name: Viren Samani, personal profile
note: Separate from the AI for Companies card system on purpose. The page is the publication; the profile is a person. Started from scratch 21 September 2026 after the first profile drafts read as corporate.

font.headline: Instrument Sans 700
font.serif: Newsreader 500 for one word at most

rules: One idea per card, readable at phone width without zooming.
The card must be useful on its own: a thing someone screenshots, not a headline someone scrolls past.
Prefer the real artefact to a designed card: the actual file, sheet, prompt or screen, shown as itself.
No former employer on the card or in the post. Authority comes from what exists and is in use.
Type is big and plain. No photographs unless Viren or a real room is in them. No stock, no icons.
At most three colours plus greys. The old way struck through is the one flourish on the then/now card.
Nothing signed on a file card. The post carries the name.
